findings.text: Changing only the final line ending after a `sql_module` statement can leave both the generated declaration and `sqlTextHash` unchanged, so the build products need not change. Fix: State that an SQL edit can change the build products and keep the raw-byte freshness requirement separate.

D6 folds both ends of an edge, so a type `P True.intro` produces a stored `type` edge to `True` even though its only constant occurrences are `P` and `True.intro`. Fix: Define `type` and `body` by the occurrence before either endpoint is folded, and use that definition for `used_in_a_type`.

The repository’s Lake template uses `text = true` for SQL inputs, so adding a file to the trace as shown there still lets a CRLF-only edit inside a string literal reuse a stale module. Fix: Require `text = false` for the Lake trace option so it hashes the original bytes.

The range-free `instInhabitedParseNode.default` example contradicts rule 3’s statement that every helper of a standalone derived instance has the class-token range. Fix: Narrow rule 3’s range claim to helpers that share the class-token range and leave range-free helpers to rule 5.
